Politics · India

Kerala Minister's remarks on women's transport choices spark controversy

Kerala Minister C.P. John has faced controversy for remarks he made regarding women's choices between using free bus services and paying for private school education for their children. The minister stated his comments were intended as self-criticism and later expressed regret, saying he had no intention of hurting or insulting anyone. He also indicated he had learned his lesson and would be more careful in the future. The CPI(M) has criticized the minister's statement.
